dfp2019:1.text: Government of Assam, Finance (Estt-B) Department. Dated Dispur, the 23rd July, 2019. The following partial amendment shall be made in Notification No. FEB.331/2015/10 dated 29th May, 2017, Schedule-I of the Delegation of Financial Power Rules, 1999 (as amended). Schedule-I: Power delegated to Administrative Departments of the Government. Sl. No. 23(ii): Issue of Sanction/Administrative approval against State share of a new or continuing Central Sector Scheme/Centrally Sponsored Scheme/RIDF Scheme including purchase of equipment and machineries provided those are part of the scheme, but except (a) Creation of Posts, (b) Engagement of Work Charge/MR/Ad-hoc and Casual Workers. Extent of power: Full power. Authority: Senior-most Secretary of the Department (powers not to be further delegated). Conditions: (a) Observance of Section 7(2) of the AFRBM Act, 2005. (b) The corresponding Govt. of India share has already been credited into the State Exchequer or the Bank account of the authorized complementary Agencies as the case may be. (c) The amount of State share to be released shall be proportionate to the actual GOI release as per the approved funding pattern of the particular centrally sponsored scheme. (d) Approval of NABARD/State Cabinet in case of RIDF. Remarks: For NESIDS/NEC, NLCPR scheme approval of T&D Department will be required as T&D Department is the nodal Department of said schemes. Memo No. FEB.75/79/Pt-I/218. Sd/- Samir K. Sinha, IAS, Principal Secretary.
